children: Tianhong Fund Management Co. said it will terminate all fund sales cooperation with UBS Fund Sales (Shenzhen) Co. from September 12, 2026, including subscriptions, purchases, redemptions, conversions and regular fixed-amount investment services, according to Jiemian News. Investors holding Tianhong Fund products through UBS Fund Sales should complete a transfer of custody or redeem their shares by 3:00 p.m. on September 11, 2026. If they do not do so by then, Tianhong Fund said it will transfer the remaining shares to its direct sales platform.

title: Tianhong Fund to End All Fund Sales Cooperation With UBS Fund Sales Shenzhen on September 12
